metas.name: Eyes
metas.description: Tina Sebastian, a police officer investigates disturbing cases involving women. As the investigation progresses, mental health professionals join forces with the police to understand the psychology of stalkers, identify warning signs and prevent situations from escalating.

metas.name: Poacher
metas.description: A group of Indian Forest Service officers, NGO workers, police constables and good samaritans risk their lives trying to track down the biggest elephant ivory poachers in the history of India and bring them to justice.

metas.name: M.E.N.A.K.A
metas.description: When Ajayan, a failed writer, declares on a television show that he will murder seven people in seven days, Jacob Anookkaran, a policeman, sets out to stop him with the help of his team.

metas.name: 1000 Babies
metas.description: Enter a cradle of mysteries where a man with a dark past manipulates multiple lives through a series of cryptic letters and deadly games.

metas.name: Kammattam
metas.description: Inspector Antonio George smells foul play in the mysterious death of Samuel Umman. As his investigation leads him to Samuel's employee, Francis, Antonio realises that a much larger game is in play.

metas.name: The Chronicles Of The 4.5 Gang
metas.description: A group of five slum boys dream of making it big amidst the chaotic world of crime, comedy, and survival.

metas.name: Kasargod Embassy
metas.description: Azi and Chemmu, cousins trapped in poverty in late 2000s Kasaragod, work for their cunning uncle Razak Mama, whose stationery shop hides a forgery racket.

metas.name: The Confession of Paul Jobson
metas.description: A film crew unknowingly welcomes a true psychopath onto their set. But when they push his buttons one too many times, their shoot turns into a deadly game of survival.
